response.sql: WITH regional_stats AS (SELECT d.A3, AVG(t.amount) as avg_amount, COUNT(*) as trans_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean FROM regional_stats), above_mean AS (SELECT rs.avg_amount, rs.trans_count, om.mean FROM regional_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE rs.avg_amount > om.mean) SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_of_averages, AVG(trans_count) as mean_of_counts, AVG(avg_amount - mean) as mean_excess FROM above_mean
